correctness.rationale: Every matching edge covers precisely six vertices; 2n vertices require k=(n+1)/3 edges. At equality the overlap budget is exactly two; distinct matching-edge starts must be separated by gaps two or three, with exactly one short gap. A complete 3-type transition matrix gives 2k+1 admissible sequences per short-gap location. The symmetric-difference alternating-cycle argument proves uniqueness of each induced perfect matching. Complete direct vertex-set and distinct edge-cover checkers corroborated n=5,8,11,14,17, but infinite result rests on proof.
